findings.summary: I read all ten files in scope in full (the nine app paths and REPORT), the whole loop-auth.mjs and every mandatory original through EOF, and checked each criterion against source, the real tests and the controller/CUA evidence. Both feature-r1 majors are fixed with real regression tests. A fenced pending command now blocks only its own request, and there is a terminal fenced state plus an atomic absent-key retirement, so unrelated requests stay usable and stale work never ACKs. The stale-409 UI path now goes reconcile → absent or fenced → explicit dismiss and reread → fresh review. All setup-r2 and setup-r4 handoffs are met. 171/171 tests, the build, the 04-C checker, both independent probes and 8 native CUA scenarios pass on the exact pinned blobs. Only minor findings remain: stale doc/page status text, the upstream-blocked same-household reconsent case (unproven, carried as open) and coverage notes. Full 05-A/05-B/05-G stay OPEN and all carried generation findings remain open.

findings.title: Stale 'response-only / not executed' status text remains in doc and page
findings.problem: Feature-r1's minor asked for doc/report/page-header status text to say what was actually executed. REPORT.md's header is updated. But the slice doc still opens with 'Stage3 response-only source candidate; not an acceptance or executed verification record', line 37 says 'These are authored assertions, not passing results', and line 43 says the session 'ran no tests'. server/review-page.mjs:4-6 still says 'The unchanged stage1 service…' and 'No tests or browser verification are claimed by this response-only stage.' The appended checkpoint sections (lines 59-85) correct the record. REPORT line 36 accurately says final checks were pending at commit time. Still, the leading status lines contradict the controller evidence attached to this candidate (171 tests, CUA, probes). This does not affect runtime.
findings.fix_check: In a later authorized revision (or the planning partial receipt), the doc header and page comment carry a dated note saying they are historical drafting labels, and the receipt records the exact-source controller results for 133a3b0. No runtime change is needed.

findings.title: Same-household post-reconsent 'not poisoned' remains unproven (upstream gate)
findings.problem: The spec requires a test showing that real withdrawal plus reconsent and a new legitimate request are not poisoned by the old intent. The test does a real withdrawal during append and a real reconsent (epoch 3), and shows no ACK, review or effect for the old key. But accepted child-setup returns setup_unavailable for old-epoch profiles, so no same-household request can be created through current APIs. The positive control uses a different household, which shares no state with the old intent and so proves little about poisoning. Code inspection supports the property: livePending filters by request_id, consent_epoch is part of the pin and fenced() compares pins, so an old intent cannot block a new request. The slice forbids changing upstream, so this cannot be fixed within scope. REPORT:38-40 and the doc :83-85 disclose it honestly.
findings.fix_check: The planning partial receipt lists 'same-household post-reconsent review recovery: unproven, blocked by accepted child-setup old-epoch gate' as an open carried finding. Any future authorized profile-remediation slice adds the same-household test. No full-card or privacy-restoration claim is made.

findings.title: Reviewer coverage: complete mandatory reading; stated limits
findings.problem: Read in full through EOF this round. Planning originals: SOURCE_OF_TRUTH, AGENTS, GOVERNANCE, APPROVALS; PROJECT_CONTEXT v1.98, lines 1-1342 in four chunks; PRODUCT_V1 (262 lines) and PRODUCT_DECISIONS (86). The four engineering-v1 files (README, ENGINEERING_DESIGN_V1 lines 1-411, MODULE_GUIDE, REVIEW_NOTES). CODEX-05-B; 00-B CONTRACTS (1-318); 00-C SCREEN_CONTRACT_MAP (1-174). The approved SYNTHETIC_REVIEW_LIFECYCLE_SLICE, REVIEW_LOCAL_SLICE_SPEC, the REVIEW-LOCAL-01.json grant, REVIEW-LOCAL-01-SETUP4.json and REVIEW_LOCAL_FOURTH_SETUP_REVIEW.md. Generation: 05-G GENERATION_CONTRACT, the app GENERATION_LOCAL_SLICE.md and its REPORT, and the slice-result JSON with carried findings. The 04-C ACCEPTANCE_NOTES. Setup r1, r2, r3 and r4, and feature-r1 with its controller output. App, read in full: migration 014, review-service, review-journal, review-client, review-page, the whole of loop-auth.mjs, both review test files, the slice doc and REPORT. Limits: I recomputed no git blob or SHA-256 pin; the source pins and CUA source_blobs are compared as supplied. I did not read review_slice_probe.mjs, draft-fixture.mjs, generation-service.mjs or request-queue.mjs in full; I used their called interfaces (validateFixtureDraft, serializeQueueWork, project, generation.read) as exercised by real tests. WORK_MODULES_V1 is not mandatory and was not read. I could not run anything; check results come from the controller output supplied.
findings.fix_check: No action. A later round re-reads any original that changes.

findings.title: Native CUA covers the fenced path, not the held pre-insert absence variant
findings.problem: The 8 CUA scenarios match the exact runtime blobs. pending-recovery includes the new Retry→409→fenced→dismiss→fresh-ACK flow. The absent-retirement race (original held between source read and insert) is tested only by an actual HTTP/JSDOM test (ui:361), a service test (service:57) and the independent controller test, not in the native browser. The CUA limitations disclose this. The spec requires 'actual HTTP/DOM' for this case, which is met.
findings.fix_check: The planning receipt keeps the stated CUA limitation verbatim.

findings.title: After 64 retirements, a new unknown intent cannot be dismissed in-page
findings.problem: Once a household holds 64 absence markers, reconcile of a never-committed key returns 503 configuration_missing (as setup-r4 required: no quarantine, existing state usable). The UI treats 503 as 'Outcome unknown'. It keeps the intent and offers only Retry/Reconcile, and the request select stays disabled while intent exists. Retrying a stale command keeps returning 409. Only pagehide/reload clears the intent. The behaviour is safe (no false save, no replacement key), but the doc does not describe this UI consequence of saturation.
findings.fix_check: The doc mentions that at saturation the page cannot dismiss a new unknown intent and must be reloaded, or a later revision adds a distinct non-success UI message for configuration_missing.

findings.title: Host diff adds a trailing blank line at EOF
findings.problem: The spec says 'Existing loop-auth formatting preserved'. The semantic hunks are isolated new lines and do not reflow accepted code (good, and responsive to the 04-C formatting nit), but the diff also appends an empty line at EOF.
findings.fix_check: No action needed; optionally drop the extra blank line in a later authorized touch.
